verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no native versioning, change review, or rollback for incident.io Workflows or other automations. The Terraform provider changelog entry describes infra-as-code management, but any versioning or rollback would come from the user's own Git/Terraform workflow, which is a user-side workaround. Audit logs that track configuration changes are an adjacent control, not versioning or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
